```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
grid <- st_read("data/processed_grid/processed_grid.shp")
grid_df <- tibble(grid) # tibble will run summarize faster!
```

```{r}
names(grid)

grid_df %>%
    filter(n_wldfr > 0) %>%
    mutate(has_rx = n_rx_fr > 0) %>%
    group_by(has_rx) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_acres = mean(max_crs, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_acres = median(max_crs, na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_dur = mean(mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_dur = median(mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE),
        n=n()
    )

```

Grid cells with wildfires and without prescribed burns had more acres burned (by mean and median) than those with prescribed burns, and shorter mean duration but longer median duration.

```{r}
grid_df %>%
    filter(n_wldfr > 0) %>%
    mutate(has_rx = n_rx_fr > 0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(has_rx, max_crs, fill=has_rx)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_y_log10() + 
    theme_minimal()

grid_df %>%
    filter(n_wldfr > 0) %>%
    mutate(
        has_rx = n_rx_fr > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(has_rx, mx_sz_c) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    group_by(has_rx) %>%
    mutate(
        total = sum(n),
        pct_sz = n/total
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(mx_sz_c, pct_sz, fill=has_rx)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    theme_minimal()

```
